name: rex
title: Rex Sessions
description: Find Rex sessions, tabs, and panes on this Mac and your remote hosts, see what runs in each, and jump straight to them
author: mike-the-brain

commands.name: search-panes
commands.title: Search Panes
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Find any terminal pane across all Rex sessions and hosts by title, running program, directory, or agent status, preview its screen, and jump to it

commands.name: search-tabs
commands.title: Search Tabs
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Find a Rex tab by session, label, terminal title, running program, or directory, preview its screen, and jump to it

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Sessions
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Find a Rex session on this Mac or a remote host, see its tabs and running agents, and jump to it

preferences.name: rexPath
preferences.title: Rex CLI
preferences.description: Path to the rex command-line tool or to the Rex app bundle. Leave empty to use Rex.app or Rex Beta.app from /Applications.

preferences.name: activateApp
preferences.title: After Jumping
preferences.label: Bring Rex to the front
preferences.description: Activate the Rex app after focusing the chosen tab or pane.

preferences.name: liveRefresh
preferences.title: Fallback Refresh
preferences.label: Also poll every 15 seconds
preferences.description: Changes arrive instantly from Rex's event stream; this adds a slow poll in case the stream drops.

preferences.name: tabPills
preferences.title: Tab Icons
preferences.description: How many pane pills to stack on a tab's icon, like Rex's tab bar.

preferences.name: detailLevel
preferences.title: Information
preferences.description: How much each row shows: Normal has every accessory, Reduced keeps status and program, Minimal shows only titles and pills.

preferences.name: attentionStyle
preferences.title: Blocked, Done, Error
preferences.description: How a pane that needs you is marked on its pill. Dot is what Rex's tab bar shows.

data.title: Rex's status badge art on the pill

preferences.name: progressStyle
preferences.title: Progress
preferences.description: How a program reporting progress is shown. Pie replaces the glyph with Rex's progress ring.

preferences.name: workingStyle
preferences.title: Working
preferences.description: How a program that is busy without a known progress is shown. Rex animates three dots at the tab's edge.
